A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same DeNOTS research, with readable main text, equations, tables, figures and complete appendices. Related work and appendix sections can be matched across relocation and renumbering.

before.justification: V3 reports original benchmark results in Table 7, synthetic experiments, robustness tests and appendix forecasting results.

after.justification: V4 retains those original empirical results and reports revised Sine-Mix outcomes in Table 4.

M1.justification: Both versions use time scaling, natural cubic spline interpolation, the Anti-NF GRU vector field and a linear prediction head. Reorganized backbone descriptions and clarified GRU notation do not change the procedure.

E1.justification: The four main benchmarks, Bump, Sine-Mix, Sine-2, Pendulum-Angles forecasting and drop/change attack scenarios are retained. Regular and irregular forecasting coverage also remains unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the main benchmarks, Sine-Mix test, vector-field comparisons and forecasting experiment. The added GRU-ODE paragraph in Appendix C.2 restates the construction already described in v3.

E3.justification: V4 Section 4.3 now describes Sine-Mix outcomes after five training epochs. V3 provides no experiment-specific epoch count, while both versions retain the general validation-based stopping policy. The PDFs do not resolve whether the evaluation checkpoint changed or was merely newly disclosed; other reported settings match.

E4.justification: The Sine-Mix forgetfulness analysis replaces the account of Sync-NF failing on one of three seeds with a five-run summary described after five epochs, and revises the GRU success account. Other ablations and robustness analyses are retained; the overfitting experiment is relocated rather than newly added.

E5.justification: Table 4 changes its reported averaging from three runs to five, while still providing no dispersion estimates. Main-result uncertainty reporting, negative-feedback strength bands and the 25-run attack averaging procedure remain unchanged.

E6.justification: In Table 4, GRU's reported R2 changes from 1 to 0.8 and Sync-NF's from 0.6 to 0.3; the other entries are unchanged. These are revised averages with changed run aggregation and newly stated epoch information, rather than established same-setting performance changes. Main and matched appendix benchmark values remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The time-scaling, stability, GP-error and memory theorems and their appendix proofs are retained. V4 clarifies the Lx/Lh ordering in main-text Assumption 4.1 to match their existing use in the derivations. The new expressivity discussion is conceptual rather than a new formal derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same time-scaling, Anti-NF, stability, robustness, memory and benchmark-superiority claims, including the claim of up to 20% improvement. No core contribution is added or withdrawn.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 adds qualifications about which information is important across datasets and samples. New Appendix C.4 distinguishes approximation, estimation and training errors, then argues that the latter two have been ruled out using the existing stopping policy and overfitting experiment. The stated limitations otherwise remain unchanged.

D1.justification: V4 newly supplies the five-epoch context for the Sine-Mix results. Its reproducibility statement consolidates code access and pipeline information already present in v3; hardware, implementation settings and resource links otherwise remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 49 referenced works and substantive research positioning are retained. Related work moves from Section 6 to Appendix A, and citations switch to author-year style or move between tables and descriptions.

P1.justification: V4 adds a roadmap and reproducibility statement, expands the forgetfulness explanation, and incorporates the earlier overfitting subsection into a new expressivity discussion. Related work and backbone descriptions are reorganized, and affiliations are updated, while most prose is retained.

P2.justification: The title, headings, headers and page flow are reformatted. Table 7's citations and footnotes are simplified or relocated, and the overfitting table moves from Table 13 to Table 11. All sixteen figures and fourteen tables are retained, with unchanged plotted content.

improvement.justification: V4 offers useful clarification of forgetfulness and more explicit Sine-Mix reporting. However, new Appendix C.4 claims training and estimation errors are ruled out without adding controls that establish this; it reuses the existing stopping policy and overfitting experiment. The five-epoch Sine-Mix description also leaves protocol comparability unresolved. These clarity gains and evidential concerns prevent a reliable judgment of net overall improvement.
